versions.changelog:
- Initial release of claude-md skill.
- Generates or prunes a CLAUDE.md by extracting only repository rules that directly prevent concrete agent errors.
- Ensures all included guidance is verified from actual build scripts, CI, and code, omitting unsupported or placeholder information.
- Sections for build, test, architecture, and conventions focus on necessary conditions, exceptional cases, and exception handling.
- Removes unverifiable statements and duplicates, streamlining guidance to actionable, error-preventing content only.
